rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something may happen or may have a given result.

example.english: This decision could potentially affect the whole plan.
example.traditional: 呢個決定可能會影響成個計劃。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 ho2 nang4 wui5 jing2 hoeng2 sing4 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this fuller phrase when explicitly stressing that an outcome is possible, especially before a clause.

example.english: If it rains heavily again, the road could potentially flood.
example.traditional: 如果再落大雨，條路有可能會水浸。
example.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 zoi3 lok6 daai6 jyu5 tiu4 lou6 jau5 ho2 nang4 wui5 seoi2 zam3

rows.note: Use this when the possible event could happen at any moment or is especially imminent.

example.english: The lift could potentially stop at any moment.
example.jyutping: bou6 sing1 gong3 gei1 ceoi4 si4 wui5 ting4
